projects.name: VTrans Projects - Planned Project Segments
projects.notes: Line projects in development, from the VTrans VPINS project system. This layer holds only not-yet-built projects; projects under construction are in separate layers 2 (points) and 3 (segments) of the same service. ProgressIndicatorStatus has values Planned / Development / Construction. Other useful fields: Program, FHWAWorkType, PlannedBidYear, PlannedConstructionYear, ExpectedConstructionStart, Town, FactSheet (URL), ProjectManager. ExpectedBidDate is often null; PlannedConstructionYear is filled more often. Geometry is Vermont State Plane metres (ask for outSR=4326).

projects.name: VTrans Projects - Planned Project Points
projects.notes: Point projects (bridges, culverts, intersections, airports, park-and-rides) in development; same fields as the segments layer. 31 distinct work types in total; the first 25 are listed (the rest: Stormwater Mitigation, Town Hwy Bridge Reconstruction/Rehabilitation, Traffic & Safety HSIP / Signal Mgmt, Transportation Alternatives).

parcels_statewide.name: VT Data - Statewide Standardized Parcel Data - parcel polygons (VCGI)
parcels_statewide.notes: Statewide parcel polygons with the town Grand List joined on. OWNER2 holds a second owner. There is no county field: TOWN / TNAME give the municipality. LAND_LV and IMPRV_LV split the value. GLYEAR is the grand list year (2025 in the sample). No use restriction is stated on the service itself; the VCGI open data page was not checked for licence text.

summary: Both sources work: VTrans publishes planned projects (points and lines) with cost, stage and dates, and VCGI publishes statewide parcels with owner name and mailing address.
